- [ASSISTANT_SAID] One software platform for obesity consultants is "Obesity Algorithm®" developed by the Obesity Medicine Association.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The platform provides evidence-based guidelines for the assessment, management, and treatment of obesity, as well as tools and resources for healthcare professionals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The platform includes a comprehensive algorithm that guides clinicians through the decision-making process for obesity treatment, along with patient handouts and calculators.
